content_sections.heading: Kamala Nehru College Delhi Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for Kamala Nehru College Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant Professor post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 1500 per lecture, with a maximum of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What are the eligibility criteria for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Eligibility criteria are as per UGC Regulations and University of Delhi norms/guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of Kamala Nehru College Delhi?
faq.answer: The official website is www.knc.du.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview and Document Verification.
